# Gaza Casualty Tracker — Live Verified Statistics

> Live, verified casualty statistics for Gaza, sourced from the Gaza
> Ministry of Health daily reports, aggregated by Tech for Palestine and
> cross-referenced with UN OCHA. Updated automatically every day.
> No estimates, no extrapolation — only published figures.

The tracker is available in English and Arabic. All numbers are also
published as machine-readable JSON.

## Key pages

- [English dashboard](https://sharifder.github.io/Gaza-Genocide/): live stats, trend charts, FAQ
- [Arabic dashboard](https://sharifder.github.io/Gaza-Genocide/ar.html): نفس البيانات بالعربية
- [Latest statistics (JSON)](https://sharifder.github.io/Gaza-Genocide/data/latest_stats.json): current cumulative figures with source metadata
- [Full daily history (JSON)](https://sharifder.github.io/Gaza-Genocide/data/history.json): one record per day since 2023-10-07 (killed, injured, children, women)
- [Source code](https://github.com/SharifDer/Gaza-Genocide): the open-source pipeline behind this site

## Data sources

- Gaza Ministry of Health — official daily casualty reports
- Tech for Palestine, Palestine Datasets — https://data.techforpalestine.org (machine-readable aggregation)
- UN OCHA — https://www.ochaopt.org (displacement, hospital functionality)

## Methodology notes

- Figures are official reports and represent a minimum count: victims
  under the rubble and unidentified bodies are not fully included.
- The known-by-name victim list is published separately by the Gaza MoH
  and aggregated at https://data.techforpalestine.org.
